findings: Approve action opens a modal — The review checklist specifies 'approve (no modal)', but the implementation opens a form modal for an optional note. plan.md explicitly includes this form, making this a spec-vs-checklist conflict. Decide: remove the form for one-click approval, or update the checklist to accept the modal.

reject / return minLength(5) divergence — LeaveRequestResource has ->required() only on the rejection reason and return note; the new page adds ->minLength(5) to both. An approver on the resource can submit a one-character string; the pending page rejects it. Add minLength(5) to LeaveRequestResource or remove it from the page.
